name: What kind of paint is best for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, a durable, moisture-resistant paint is essential. Semi-gloss or satin finishes are often recommended as they are easier to clean and stand up well to humidity. Mildew-resistant paints are also a good choice to help prevent mold growth in a damp environment. We typically use high-quality acrylic latex paints that offer excellent durability and mildew resistance for bathroom applications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, moisture-resistant paints like semi-gloss or satin finishes are best for bathrooms to prevent mold and make cleaning easier.
